SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.order_no, po.supplier_id, bp.partner_name AS supplier_name, po.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, po.order_date, po.expected_delivery_date, po.receipt_status
FROM purchase_order po
INNER JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = po.supplier_id AND bp.company_id = po.company_id
INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = po.warehouse_id AND w.company_id = po.company_id
WHERE po.company_id = #{companyId} AND po.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND po.receipt_status IN ('NOT_RECEIVED', 'PARTIAL') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order_item poi WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = po.purchase_order_id AND poi.received_qty < poi.base_ordered_qty )
ORDER BY po.order_date DESC, po.purchase_order_id DESC

SELECT poi.purchase_order_item_id, poi.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.lot_managed_yn, poi.product_unit_id, u.unit_code, u.unit_name, poi.ordered_qty, poi.conversion_qty, poi.base_ordered_qty, poi.received_qty, ( poi.base_ordered_qty - poi.received_qty ) AS remaining_base_qty
FROM purchase_order_item poi
INNER JOIN purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id = poi.purchase_order_id
INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_id = poi.product_id AND p.company_id = po.company_id
INNER JOIN product_unit pu ON pu.product_unit_id = poi.product_unit_id AND pu.product_id = poi.product_id
INNER JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id = pu.unit_id
WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND po.company_id = #{companyId} AND po.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND po.receipt_status IN ('NOT_RECEIVED', 'PARTIAL') AND poi.received_qty < poi.base_ordered_qty
ORDER BY poi.purchase_order_item_id

SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.company_id, po.warehouse_id, po.order_date, po.approval_status, po.receipt_status
FROM purchase_order po
WHERE po.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND po.company_id = #{companyId}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM purchase_order_item poi
WHERE poi.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND poi.received_qty < poi.base_ordered_qty
